heading: About Me
content:
I am a dedicated **A/L Physics teacher** with over a decade of experience helping students master one of the most challenging subjects in the Advanced Level curriculum.

My teaching philosophy is built on three pillars:

- **Deep Conceptual Understanding** — Not just memorizing formulas, but truly understanding the physics behind them
- **Problem-Solving Mastery** — Systematic approaches to tackle any exam question with confidence
- **Exam-Oriented Preparation** — Strategic preparation with past papers, model papers, and time management techniques

I have guided **hundreds of students** to achieve outstanding results in their A/L examinations, with many going on to pursue engineering, medicine, and other prestigious fields.

Whether you're just starting your A/L journey or need intensive revision before the exam, I bring the same **passion, patience, and expertise** to every session.

heading: What I Offer
subheading: Comprehensive support for every stage of your A/L Physics journey

items.title: Theory Classes
items.description: Comprehensive coverage of the **entire A/L Physics syllabus** including Mechanics, Waves, Electricity, Magnetism, and Modern Physics. Each topic is taught with clear explanations, real-world examples, and visual aids.

items.title: Paper Classes
items.description: Intensive **past paper and model paper** practice sessions. Learn time management, question analysis techniques, and marking-scheme strategies to maximize your score.

items.title: Group Sessions
items.description: Small **group classes** (max 15 students) that combine the benefits of collaborative learning with personalized attention. Discussion-based approach helps cement understanding.

items.title: Individual Tutoring
items.description: **One-on-one sessions** tailored to your specific needs. Ideal for students who need focused attention on particular topics or accelerated revision programs.

items.title: Online Classes
items.description: **Live interactive online classes** with screen sharing, digital whiteboard, and recorded sessions. Study from anywhere without compromising on quality.

items.title: Online Paper System
items.description: Access our exclusive **online MCQ practice platform** with timed papers, instant grading, and detailed performance analytics. Practice anytime, anywhere.
